issue_context.title: Unable to use uv tool install for specific versions
issue_context.body:
<!--
Thank you for taking the time to report an issue! We're glad to have you involved with uv.

If you're filing a bug report, please consider including the following information:

* A minimal code snippet that reproduces the bug.
* The command you invoked (e.g., `uv pip sync requirements.txt`), ideally including the `--verbose` flag.
* The current uv platform.
* The current uv version (`uv --version`).
-->

```
❯ uv --version
uv 0.3.5 (6c62d9fbf 2024-08-27)
```

OSX

```
❯ uv tool install codecov-cli@0.7.4
error: Failed to parse: `codecov-cli@0.7.4`
  Caused by: Expected path (`/Users/damien/Development/mlkite/0.7.4`) to end in a supported file extension: `.whl`, `.zip`, `.tar.gz`, `.tar.bz2`, `.tar.xz`, or `.tar.zst`
codecov-cli@0.7.4
```

I am trying to install a specific version but get the above error.
comments:
Ahh, this needs to be `uv tool install codecov-cli==0.7.4`.

Tracked here: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/6535.
We'll do this today, you're not the first to run into it.
Thanks, I didn't find that when I was searching. Great project!

review_comments: This part here doesn't exist in `uv tool run`, because there, we always resolve an ephemeral environment and recreate it if any dependencies changed. Here, we need to ensure that we upgrade when re-resolving the tool environment.
I was hoping to merge that today too. Unsure if it's 100% right even though Konsti tried it?
Refresh all? Or just refresh Ruff?
In `uv tool run` at least we refresh everything. I think we might have to refresh everything here because we don't know the package name yet...?
